hooks.command: in=$(cat); if echo "$in" | grep -qE '"file_path": ?"[^"]*(index\.html|/docs/[^"]*\.html|\.css)"' && ! echo "$in" | grep -qE '"file_path": ?"[^"]*/templates/'; then echo 'Edited a GitHub Pages file - apply the update-pages skill: ship it, watch the pages build for the pushed SHA, and report live/stuck/failed proactively.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

in=$(cat); msg=''; if echo "$in" | grep -qE '"file_path": ?"[^"]*CLAUDE\.md"'; then msg='CLAUDE.md changed - the copy injected at session start is now stale; re-read the file before relying on project instructions.'; elif echo "$in" | grep -qE '"file_path": ?"[^"]*(\.claude/settings\.json|plugins/directives-toolkit/(agents|hooks|scripts)/)'; then msg='Hook/agent configuration changed - it loads only at session start; takes effect next session, do not assume it is live.'; fi; if [ -n "$msg" ]; then echo "$msg" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

echo 'BLOCKED by directives subscribe-gate: PR-activity subscription is disabled (git.md -> PR Lifecycle, owner ruling 2026-08-14). The subscribe confirmation is rendered into the transcript at call time and cannot be suppressed afterwards. Track the PR with ScheduleWakeup instead (~5 min), then read CI, labels and review threads directly before merging.' >&2; exit 2
